title: The David Rubenstein Show: Peer to Peer Conversations Celebrates 10 Years
description:
For a decade, David Rubenstein has sat down with some of the biggest names in business, finance, politics and culture. We look back at 10 of the most memorable moments from "The David Rubenstein Show: Peer to Peer Conversations."
